title: Laguna Gloria sculpture grounds
vibe: Lake light, old villa, outdoor sculpture, shade.
prompt: Walk the grounds slowly, then sit near the water before leaving.
why: It is one of Austin's best combinations of beauty, art, and low-friction wandering.

title: Mayfield Park and Preserve
vibe: Peacocks, palms, lily ponds, stone paths.
prompt: Start in the cottage gardens, then take one preserve trail loop.
why: It feels like an Austin pocket world: lush, odd, compact, and restorative.

title: Wild Basin Wilderness Preserve
vibe: Limestone trails, oak shade, creek quiet.
prompt: Take a short loop and treat it as a reset, not a workout.
why: A low-noise way to get Hill Country texture without leaving town.

title: Zilker Botanical Garden
vibe: Japanese garden, cactus forms, skyline glimpses.
prompt: Pick two gardens, skip completionism, and linger where the light is good.
why: It is close, beautiful, and better when approached as a mood rather than an errand.

title: Lady Bird Lake Boardwalk
vibe: Water, skyline, open air, city motion.
prompt: Walk the boardwalk stretch, then stop for the skyline instead of rushing the loop.
why: It is the easiest beautiful urban walk in Austin when the weather cooperates.

title: Kingsbury Commons at Pease Park
bestTime: Morning with kids or early evening
vibe: Big trees, limestone, play structures, picnic energy.
prompt: Use it as a light family outing: short walk, shade, snack, done.
why: A polished but still local-feeling park surface for family time or a simple decompression walk.

title: Covert Park at Mount Bonnell
vibe: Stone steps, river bend, classic Austin view.
prompt: Go when you only have a small window and want a real view fast.
why: It is obvious for a reason: a quick elevation change can reset the day.

title: Elisabet Ney Museum
vibe: Limestone studio, sculpture, Hyde Park calm.
prompt: Treat it as a miniature architecture-and-art stop, then walk the neighborhood.
why: A small, distinctive Austin cultural place that rewards curiosity without demanding a whole afternoon.
